name: Affiliate Product Boxes
author: upscalewp

sections.description:
Affiliate Product Boxes is built for affiliate bloggers who want to:

  • Add and manage products manually
  • Design product boxes based on your theme layout
  • Insert customizable product boxes using shortcodes

Current Features:

  • Custom post type: “Affiliate Products”
  • Fields for title, description, price, affiliate link, rating, thumbnail
  • Shortcode to embed product box in posts
  • Admin settings to control appearance (e.g. button color)

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via the Plugins menu
  3. Start adding products via the “Affiliate Products” menu
  4. Use [apbox_product_box id="123"] in posts/pages
sections.faq:
How do I display an affiliate product on a blog page?

In the text editor, simply add a shortcode using [apbox_product_box id="123"]

My blog page displays the following error: ‘Invalid product ID.’

Please make sure that the ID added to your shortcode actually contains a valid product ID. To do that, open the product under ‘Affiliate Products’ and check the ID in the browser (‘post=ID’).

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes, go to Admin Settings → Styling Options.

Can I import products automatically?

Coming soon in the PRO version, with Amazon and other affiliate APIs.
